title: A Simple 90 Day Marketing Plan for a Medical Practice
desc: A month by month plan to fix the basics, grow your visibility and keep new patients coming.
text:
Marketing feels huge when you try to do everything at once. A simpler way is to follow a plan with one clear focus each month. This 90 day plan fits a busy practice and needs no big budget to start.

## Month 1: Fix the basics
The first month is about making sure patients can find you and trust what they see. Before spending on ads, fix the foundation.
- Claim and fully fill in your Google Business Profile
- Make your name, address and phone number match on every listing
- Check that your website loads fast on phones
- Add a clear phone number and a booking button on every page
- Run a free scan to see your starting point

By the end of the month you should have a clean, correct online presence and a list of what to improve next.

## Month 2: Grow your visibility
Now that the basics are right, help more people discover you. This month is about content and proof.
- Write one page for each main service you offer
- Publish two helpful blog posts that answer real patient questions
- Start asking every happy patient for a review with a direct link
- Add real photos of your team and your office to your website and profile

Content takes time to work, so start early. Pages and posts you write now will bring patients for years.

## Month 3: Turn visitors into patients
In the third month, focus on catching the people who are already coming and on reaching new ones faster.
- Add an AI chat assistant to answer questions after hours
- Test a small Google Ads budget for your best service
- Follow up with every new lead quickly, ideally within five minutes
- Set up simple tracking for calls and form fills

Speed matters here. Most patients book with the first practice that answers.

## Track only what matters
Do not drown in numbers. Each month, look at just four things:
1. Phone calls from Google
2. New patient bookings
3. Number of reviews and your star rating
4. Website visits from search

Write them in one simple sheet so you can compare month to month.

## Keep going after day 90
When the 90 days end, look at what worked and do more of it. Stop or change what did not help. Marketing is not a one time job, and small steady work beats a big push that stops.
